notes: Box chosen in Sunnyside / Glen Park west of Bosworth (Monterey Blvd, Congo, Baden, Joost, Mangels, Teresita Blvd, Kenyon, Martha, Nordhoff, Circular Ave and the Southern Pacific line): a plain grid beside curved hillside blocks, black (commercial) strips along Monterey Blvd, street ends closed by a long shared line, two blocks parted only by a thin line, and the railway. Kept east of the Balboa Park / City College open land and west of the legend. Seeds, plus strokes: (1) the line at y 1135 from x 3747 to the crop's east edge is shared by the blocks north of it (3062, 3060, 3030) and the blocks south of it (the strip with 'ST. 6784' at 3759-3902 x 1135-1167, and the L-shaped block at 3920- x 1135-), and it closes the ends of the two streets at x 3820-3848 and 3918-3940: stroke along it; a stroke at x 3759 (1137-1171) parts the strip from the end of 3062's west line. (2) The thin line at y 1040-1042 from the diagonal street to the east edge is read as the line between blocks 3030A (north) and 3030 (south): stroke along it. The dotted line at x 4018 (1043-1135) inside 3030 is read as a lot line, not a block edge, and gets no stroke. (3) Strokes on outlines too faint for the paper threshold, which let the street into the hatching: x 3214 (699-914) and x 3292 (845-914) on block 3142; x 3646 (1182-1398) on block 6785; x 3618 (1232-1290) on the block east of Monterey Blvd. FOR THE OWNER TO RULE ON: (a) The Southern Pacific right of way (two lines with the track drawn dashed between, from about 3100,1005 to 3290,1454) is left as street, as the fill made it (railway lines are neither block edge); its track pieces are unseeded islands (street): 3169,1129; 3212,1189; 3361,1447; 3294,1339 is lettering. (b) The strip west of Judson Ave's west line at the crop's west edge (3100-3102 x 430-537) is land with no outline of its own (the City College / Balboa reservoir ground) and is marked open. (c) The narrow outlined piece at the west end of block 3028 (3905-3920 x 470-520) joins the block where its outline touches; it may be a separate lot or walk. (d) 3101,1013 is Circular Ave paper cut off by the crop edge and lettering, left as street. Leak closed with a stroke at (4001, 516) (second look, 2026-11-23). OWNER (2026-11-23), shown this crop, circled the top of the blocks at about x 3570-3700, y 440-600: "you missed a very thin mid-block path, which is not the end of the world. I would accept that as a reasonable failure." Left as drawn.
